   - **Objective mismatch**: BCE trains per-neuron binary classification but inference uses global top-k (structural incompatibility)
   - **Cross-scale generalization**: KL distillation method transfers from LLaMA-8B to Qwen-14B with identical TEAL PPL ratio (1.47x)
